    """
    Convert three lists into a list of nested dictionaries.

def same_order(list1, list2):
    """
    Check if the common elements between two lists are in the same order.
    
    Args:
        list1: First list
        list2: Second list
    
    Returns:
        True if common elements appear in the same order in both lists, False otherwise.
    """
    # Find common elements
    common = set(list1) & set(list2)
    
    # Extract common elements from each list in their original order
    common_in_list1 = [x for x in list1 if x in common]
    common_in_list2 = [x for x in list2 if x in common]
    
    # Check if the order is the same
    return common_in_list1 == common_in_list2
